subject: South Korea COVID-19 Response
overview: Host Anna Callahan interviewed software engineer Howard Kim about his travel from Somerville to South Korea during the COVID-19 pandemic. Kim described South Korea's quarantine and testing protocols and compared its public health response to that of the United States.

items.title: Introduction of Howard Kim
items.summary: Anna Callahan introduced Somerville resident Howard Kim to discuss living in South Korea during the COVID-19 outbreak.

items.title: Travel and Quarantine Experience in South Korea
items.summary: Howard Kim detailed undergoing airport testing upon arrival in Seoul, followed by a mandatory two-week monitored quarantine supported by government care packages.

items.title: Comparison of South Korean and US Pandemic Responses
items.summary: Kim and Callahan discussed differences in testing availability, public trust, and universal healthcare between South Korea and the United States.
